connector.name: Dotnet Coverage MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for .NET coverage: run tests, parse Cobertura, find uncovered branches, append tests.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package dotnet-coverage-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hyeonu-cha account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: COVERAGE_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOT
env.description: Restrict every tool's filesystem access to this subtree. Recommended for shared environments. When unset, the server logs a warning and accepts any path.

env.name: COVERAGE_MCP_DOTNET_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Override the dotnet test timeout in milliseconds. Default: 600000 (10 minutes).
